text:
The Nifty 50 edged up 0.06% to 25,044.65, while the broader Nifty 500 rose 0.47% to 23,567.0, indicating a modest but positive move across most stocks. Advances (314) outpaced declines (174) and the breadth score of 71.8 stays in the “HEALTHY” zone, with three‑quarters of stocks above their 20‑day moving average. The India VIX fell slightly to 17.42, suggesting lower near‑term volatility.

Foreign Institutional Investors (FIIs) were net buyers of about ₹7,212 crore today, extending a 9‑day buying streak, while Domestic Institutional Investors (DIIs) sold roughly ₹7,173 crore, marking a 7‑day selling run. Leading sectors included Pharma, Private Bank, Capital Markets and Healthcare, whereas IT, Infrastructure and Oil & Gas showed weakening. In options, Nifty’s put‑call ratio (PCR) is 1.07, with a max‑pain level at 25,000 and a call wall at 26,000, hinting that downside protection is modest. Bank Nifty’s PCR is 1.27, max‑pain at 57,700 and a tight expected range of 58,415‑61,067.

Watch the Nifty pivot points: support at 24,894, pivot at 24,989 and resistance at 25,140. A break below 24,894 could test the 20‑day average (≈24,900) while a move above 25,140 may target the 25,200 level mentioned in analyst notes. Keep an eye on global cues – US inflation data and Fed rate‑hike expectations – as they continue to influence Indian market sentiment.
